pattern: ^\[Win32App\]\[DetectionActionHandler\] Detection for policy with id: (?<id>{GUID}) resulted in action status: Success and detection state: (?<detection>DetectedDifferentVersion|NotDetected|Detected)
description: Captures the detection rule result after IME runs detection for an app. 'Detected' means the detection rule matched (app is installed), 'NotDetected' means it did not, 'DetectedDifferentVersion' means a different version was found (supersedence / WinGet version mismatch). DetectedDifferentVersion must come first in the alternation so the unanchored regex does not mis-capture its 'Detected' prefix. Excludes [SimulatedDetectionActionHandler] which fires during applicability pre-checks.
